description: The metadata of a dataset that is already published, as the researcher gives it: its identifier, title, licence, keywords, creators, formats, related outputs and how it is accessed.

schema_class.description: Type designator: the name of the class this object is an instance of. Discriminates the input and payload unions, and lets a consumer name a payload class it does not recognise.

identifier.description: The dataset's persistent identifier or landing page, e.g. a DOI or URL.

licence.description: The dataset's licence, e.g. an SPDX identifier such as CC-BY-4.0.

creators.description: The names of the dataset's creators.

creator_identifiers.description: Identifiers of the creators, e.g. ORCID iDs.

formats.description: The media types of the dataset's files, e.g. text/csv.

related_identifiers.description: Identifiers of related outputs, e.g. the DOI of an article that uses the data.

access_protocol.description: The protocol by which the data are retrieved, e.g. https.
